title: 第二十五章 先招惹他的第二十六章 乐此不疲
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
“彦褚！
快快快，有事找你，跟我来一下！”
话音未落，人已经被拽走了。
月翎僵在原地。
她的手还维持着抬起的动作，却只能眼睁睁看着彦褚被拖得越来越远。
她想不管不顾追上去拦住。
可她知道不行，那样目的性太强，会让人起疑。
月翎深吸一口气，慢慢把手放下来。
好在已经在彦褚面前打了照面。
就算参加不了慰问活动，以后见面打个招呼，总有机会的。
她转过身往回走，心里还是有些不甘。
彦褚明明是三个目标里看起来最好接近的一个。
为什么堵了他这么多次，两次近距离靠近，愣是没成？
月翎不解地思索，殊不知这一切都落在泽禹眼里。
他站在不远处的阴影里，目光穿过稀疏的枝叶，将刚才那一幕尽收眼底。
她主动叫住彦褚，冲他笑得明媚而灿烂，眼底像星星一样在发着光。
泽禹的眼底漫上一层戾气。
她每天守在这里，就是为了接近彦褚？
彦褚瘦弱不堪，容貌普通，哪里比得上他？
那双眼睛是白长的？

下次回帝都，他得带几个专家过来好好给她看看眼睛，看还能不能治好！
泽禹被气笑了，低低嗤了一声，转身便走。
月翎早上没成功种下精神力种子，傍晚兼职结束后，她又守在了那条路上。
这是她来洛克郡的主要目的，再难，也得坚持。
毕竟，这点小小的付出能改变她的命运。
时间一分一秒地流逝，天色渐渐暗下来。
就在她以为今天又要白忙一场时，视线里忽然出现一道熟悉的身影。
泽禹！
她心下一喜，立马跟了上去。
泽禹在前面走着，余光瞥见那道跟上来的身影，嘴角微微勾起。
这才对！
眼睛总算恢复正常了。
他故意放慢脚步，让她能跟上，又故意绕了几个弯。
察觉到她始终不远不近地跟着，那双一向布满阴翳的眼里，难得浮现出几分愉悦。
月翎追得有些吃力，他身高腿长，走得又快，她小跑着才能勉强不掉队。
眼看他穿过试炼场失去了踪影，心下一急，顾不上暴露，立马加快脚步追上去。
可追了一段距离，还是没见着人影。
content_en:
"Yan Chu!
Come on, come on, come on, I need you, come with me! "
Before he finished speaking, the person was already dragged away.
Yue Ling froze in place.
She kept her hand raised, but she could only watch as Yan Chu was dragged further and further.
She wanted to catch up and stop him regardless.
But she knew it wouldn't work. It would be too purposeful and would make people suspicious.
Yue Ling took a deep breath and slowly lowered her hand.
Fortunately, he had already met Yan Chu.
Even if you can't attend the condolence event, there is always a chance to meet and say hello in the future.
She turned around and walked back, still feeling a little unwilling.
Yan Chu is obviously the one who seems to be the closest among the three targets.
Why did he block him so many times and approach him at close range twice, but failed?
Yue Ling thought in confusion, but she didn't know that all of this fell into Ze Yu's eyes.
He stood in the shadow not far away, looking through the sparse branches and leaves, taking in the scene just now.
She took the initiative to stop Yan Chu and smiled brightly at him, her eyes shining like stars.
Ze Yu's eyes were filled with anger.
She stays here every day just to get close to Yan Chu?
Yan Chu was thin and average-looking, so how could he compare to him?
Are those eyes white?
Next time he returns to the imperial capital, he will have to bring some experts over to take a good look at her eyes and see if they can be cured!
Ze Yu laughed angrily, snorted lowly, turned around and left.
Yueling failed to plant the spiritual seeds in the morning. After her part-time job ended in the evening, she stayed on that road again.
This was her main purpose for coming to Rock County. No matter how difficult it was, she had to persevere.
After all, this small contribution can change her destiny.
Time passed by minute by second, and the sky gradually darkened.
Just when she thought she would be busy again in vain today, a familiar figure suddenly appeared in her sight.
Zeyu!
She was delighted and immediately followed him.
Ze Yu was walking in front, and from the corner of his eye he caught a glimpse of the figure following him, and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised.
That's right!
My eyes finally returned to normal.
He deliberately slowed down so that she could keep up, and deliberately made a few detours.
Realizing that she was always following him, a hint of joy appeared in those eyes that were always full of gloom.
Yue Ling had a hard time chasing him. He was tall and had long legs, and he walked fast. She had to jog to keep up.
Seeing him disappearing across the trial field, I felt anxious and immediately quickened my pace to catch up without caring about being exposed.
But after chasing for a distance, there was still no sign of anyone.
